hints.content: The ratio of shaded pieces to pieces per whole is $\blueE{11}:10$.

Percent means per hundred.  

So, we need an equivalent ratio that will tell us how many pieces would be shaded out of $100$ pieces per whole.

|||
-|-|-|-
Shaded | ${11}$ | $\stackrel{\times 10}\rightarrow$ | ${110}$
Parts per whole | $10$ | $\stackrel{\times 10}\rightarrow$  | $100$

![](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/31c77dcf3a87926a81df679fcfd732e298caf0f6) ![](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/fe00443958ba3a6c3f4f6bd14a1d5e50be3465ad)

We can also divide the ten pieces into a hundred and see that $\blueE{11}:10$ is equivalent to $\blueE{110}:100$.
